name: Park Hyatt Seoul
insider_take: Seoul's sophisticated crown jewel sits at the epicenter of Gangnam, where traditional Korean elegance meets ultra-modern luxury in one of Asia's most dynamic capitals.
whats_special: Park Hyatt Seoul occupies floors 24-38 of the iconic World Trade Center Tower, offering breathtaking panoramic views of the Han River and Seoul's glittering skyline. The hotel features Korea's only Club Olympus spa with traditional Korean wellness treatments, while its location puts you steps from COEX Mall - Asia's largest underground shopping complex with over 260 stores.
pro_tip: Book a river-view room on floors 35+ for spectacular sunrise views over the Han River, and time your visit during cherry blossom season (April) when nearby Banpo Rainbow Bridge creates a magical light show at sunset.
dont_miss: The hotel's Corner Stone restaurant serves exceptional Korean-French fusion cuisine, while the nearby Bongeunsa Temple offers a peaceful 1,200-year-old Buddhist sanctuary just 5 minutes away. Take advantage of the direct underground connection to Samseong Station for seamless subway access to Myeongdong, Hongdae, and other Seoul hotspots.
pros: Prime location in prestigious Gangnam district with easy access to business and shopping areas
Exceptional luxury amenities including world-class spa and fitness facilities
Outstanding dining options featuring renowned restaurants and rooftop bar with city views
Impeccable Park Hyatt service standards with personalized attention to detail
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Formal atmosphere may not suit all leisure travelers
